title: AI Transition Video: Match Cuts, Morphs, Dissolves | Flick
summary: Make an AI transition video in one prompt: match cuts, morphs, dissolves and transformations, with real clips and the words behind them. Try it free.
body_markdown:
### What is an AI transition video?


An AI transition video is a video where AI makes the passage between two pictures, instead of an editor blending them. You describe the change in the prompt, such as a match cut, a dissolve or a transformation, and the model generates it.


### What is a match cut in AI video?


A match cut joins two shots on a shape or movement they share, such as a head turn that finishes in a different place. Write the number of shots and the shared shape into one prompt, as Happy Souls Alive does.


### What is the difference between a transition video and first and last frame video?


First and last frame is one clip generated from two images, so it lands on a picture you chose. A transition video is any way of getting from one picture to another, which can be a match cut, a dissolve, a transformation or a blend in the editor.


### Can I make an AI transition video for free?


Yes, Flick has a free plan with no credit card, with 100 credits at signup and 100 credits every week. MiniMax H3 Max video runs on it, while Seedance, Kling and Veo 3.1 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).


### What is the difference between a morph and a dissolve?


A dissolve fades one picture through another, while a morph changes the shapes themselves so one thing appears to become the other. In a prompt, name which one you want and say what links the two pictures.


### Can AI morph one person into another between shots?


Yes, describe the change in stages in the prompt, as A Proper Introduction does when a drawing turns to dust and then to trees. For a blend on screen, a Morph transition in Flick's video editor works between any two clips.
